title: Give Settings a local hierarchy and configuration prerequisites

reproduction.before: Section navigation absent; Compute links to bare Settings; approvals hidden until discovery

rootCause: Flat card layout and absent section route context; discovery-dependent visibility and toast-only operation errors
implementation: Native section links and focused existing headings; same-panel history preserves drafts and reads
Coherent form column in existing components stylesheet
Saved/configured/tested/discovered/approved guidance; explicit test versus save distinction
Local operation recovery; late completions checked against session and Settings presentation
limitations: Chromium automation only; no physical device, Safari, Firefox, real browser zoom or screen reader
rollback: Revert this finding's Settings, router, Compute links, components CSS and shell-cache change together; no API or persisted-data changes

verification.command: npx playwright test e2e/settings-sections.spec.mjs e2e/navigation-context.spec.mjs e2e/refresh-state.spec.mjs e2e/compute.spec.mjs e2e/pwa.spec.mjs --reporter=line
verification.visualInspection: 320px light-theme screenshot inspected; no horizontal overflow in four viewport tests
